name: Portuguese Minor

requirements.label: Minor requirements (from LSA)
requirements.hint: Requirements Minimum Credits: 18 A minimum of 18 credits beyond PORTUG 232. PORTUG 287: Advanced Portuguese Conversation and Composition is required. Constraints Students pursuing the minor in Portuguese may petition to have up to three courses (no more than 9 credits) from other units (for example, History, Afro-American and African Studies, as well as Latin American and Caribbean Studies), taught in English, which have a Brazilian, Lusophone African, and/or Portuguese focus to count for the minor. Courses from outside the PORTUG subject be approved in advance by a Portuguese advisor in the department of Romance Languages & Literatures.
